states: Private mock stack (backend :7731 built from this clone, Vite :5251 serving this branch, base bffd21f470, after #2578 landed) with Playwright page.clock installed before load; data held by dropping /ws data frames and replaying cached API GETs while a data-free keep-alive frame per fake minute keeps one live socket (no heartbeat reconnect)

Alerts > Destinations external watchdog with an injected healthy status (lastSuccessAt 30s, lastMonitoringProgress 20s before load; the mock has no watchdog): Last success 33s ago and Monitor progress 23s ago read 10 mins ago after 10 held minutes at 1440 and 390; 20 background re-reads of /api/alerts/deadman/status in those 10 minutes, Refresh button untouched
Same page, delivery log with one injected sent email attempt 5 minutes old: the row time tooltip moved 5 mins ago to 15 mins ago
Patrol activity with an injected blocked status (blocked_at 2 minutes before load): 'Blocked 2m ago' read 'Blocked 12m ago' after 10 held minutes

Patrol activity > Finding options and history > History, newest demo run start rewritten to 3 minutes before load: row read 3m ago then 13m ago; selecting it showed 'Patrol run 3m ago' and then 'Patrol run 13m ago' while held

Patrol inbox attention detail with injected acknowledgement, timeline and evidence times (3, 5 and 7 minutes before load): read 13m, 15m and 17m ago after 10 held minutes; 'Last seen' and the flapping window stay read-time by design

Same-session control: with these five runtime files swapped back to origin/main under the running Vite, the watchdog ages, delivery tooltip, Blocked banner, selected-run banner and attention detail ages stayed frozen (one status read, no background re-reads); only the run history row moved, because history re-reads on Patrol's 60-second refresh, so that row is not changed here
No page errors at either viewport
interactions: Loaded /alerts/destinations at 1440x900 and 390x844, held the data stream and advanced the page clock ten one-minute steps
Loaded /patrol/activity, opened Finding options and history, opened History, selected the newest run, held and advanced ten minutes
Loaded /patrol, opened the first attention item's detail, held and advanced ten minutes
Repeated every scenario with the pre-change files as the control
